purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - monthly medical act aggregation by treatment category (診療行為別集計表)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It reads indexed files containing medical treatment act aggregation data (診療行為別集計) and accounting data, then produces a CSV report summarising treatment acts by category (診療区分), including point values, quantities, counts and totals. It handles both inpatient and outpatient distinctions.

notable_features: INDEXED file organisation with DYNAMIC access
CSV output generation with Japanese header literals
OCCURS tables for treatment category codes
Encoded Japanese text (EUC-JP/latin-1 decoded) in comments and literals
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Revision history embedded in comments (versions 04.06.01 through 05.00.00)
Large working storage with 20000-byte WRK-REC field
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (decoded as latin-1), causing mojibake in Japanese comments and literals. This is standard for JMA ORCA codebase. File is truncated at 16000 chars but structure is clear. The ORCBG017S program ID and file naming convention (BG017x) are consistent with the known ORCA batch reporting subsystem.
